title: Chapter 115: Terrifying Offensive
content:
Chapter 115: Terrifying Offensive

Ghouls are very patient in order for one attack to be effective, and they do not hesitate to consume a large number of ghouls to buy time.

Through the information detected by the one-star host, on the other side of the wall, those weird things have dug out a huge space that is one-third the size of the Zerg underground base.

It can be seen that things like weird things cannot be judged by common sense at all. They silently carried out such a large project in such a short period of time. If it were not for the existence of a star host, neither Wu Qing nor the ordinary Zerg would have noticed any movement.

The huge space was packed with ghouls, layer upon layer, as if all the ghouls in the large cave had been transferred here.

Now there is only a thick wall of earth and stone separating them from the Zerg underground base. As long as this wall is opened, a large number of ghouls will rush out and flood the Zerg underground base with the force of thunder.

Those weird things kept digging toward the Zerg underground base. When they dug to the edge of the Zerg territory's carpet, they stopped. Like the tide receding, they retreated silently and disappeared in an instant.

The number of ghouls in this huge space is still increasing, and all the ghouls are beginning to lean against the thin wall in the direction of the Zerg base. They are climbing up layer by layer like a stack of Arhats.

The ghoul's special body structure is not afraid of squeezing and can withstand considerable pressure.

The ghouls behind were still squeezing and climbing forward, squeezing all the pressure onto the thin wall.

The ghouls directly attached to the wall have begun to dig with their claws. The rock and soil on the wall continue to loosen, and the load-bearing capacity becomes weaker and weaker. Until a certain moment, the wall can no longer bear the terrifying squeeze of countless ghouls. pressure.

"Boom!"

All the earth and rocks in one direction of the Zerg underground base collapsed. The thin layer of earth and stone wall did not bring much soil. It only buried part of the Zerg carpet in the nearby area and slightly raised the terrain of this area. A little bit.

The large number of ghouls squeezing against this wall like stacks of arhats or human ladders are like a mountain dam that has burst, pouring down!

The ghouls at the front were condescending, rolling and crawling towards the Zerg underground base at high speed. If the attacks in front of the ghouls were water from small rivers in the mountains, their current attacks were like huge waves coming from the sky. !

From the perspective of the Zerg underground base, it looks like a tall wall made of ghouls, falling down in an instant!

This method of extreme deployment of ghoul forces instantly dropped a large number of ghouls into the attack range of the Zerg defense buildings, and there were layers of ghouls on top of each other.

The defensive buildings within the Zerg attack range were fully fired, and the dense thorns continued to rise and fall, causing huge damage to the ghouls.

But this time there were too many stacked ghouls. The ghouls below were attacked by ground thorns and disappeared. There were countless ghouls above who charged forward at high speed under the squeeze of their companions behind them. .

The air defense towers and a large number of Hydralisks behind the Zerg defensive ground were firing at full strength, but they could not stop the countless ghouls coming from behind!

"It's unstoppable! This ghoul used this method to instantly throw too many troops into the battlefield!"

Wu Qing finally saw the power of Ghoul's move, and also saw the wisdom of Ghoul.

However, the Zerg, who had already seen through all this, were also prepared.

A large number of puppies suddenly emerged from under the germ carpet and rushed towards the incoming wave of ghouls!

It was like a small wave crashing into a huge wave, and it was drowned by the huge wave without having much effect!

But all the puppies in the Zerg underground base got out and rushed towards the direction of the ghoul attack!

The thin black waves are one after another, constantly hitting the huge waves of the ghoul army! Delay the impact of the ghoul army!

Underground, countless ground thorns are constantly rising and falling, effectively killing the ghouls at the bottom. The air defense towers and hydralisks are constantly attacking the ghouls at the top, jointly reducing the density of the ghoul army.

Although he was prepared, the ghoul's attack at that moment was really fierce and extremely fast!

All the responses failed to stop some ghouls from rushing into the Zerg defense building area. For the first time, the ghoul army broke through the Zerg defense line and attacked the defense building.

This is a major victory for the ghouls!

The ghoul's claws swung at the defensive thorns. Only then did they realize that the fleshy-looking Zerg buildings had surprisingly powerful defense capabilities. The ghoul's claws could not tear through the outer layer of defense of the Zerg buildings.

The Zerg puppies rushed up and fought with the ghouls who rushed into the Zerg defense line.

The defensive buildings in the inner defensive positions of the Zerg underground base began to attack. Ground thorns continued to poke out from the side of the defensive ground thorns, accurately piercing the ghouls.

The Zerg's defense buildings and various units seemed to be in disarray, but in fact they were coordinated seamlessly. Wave after wave of puppies kept rushing towards the ghouls, offsetting the most violent first wave of attacks by the ghouls.

As the saying goes, if you make great efforts at one go, you will lose your strength again, and you will be exhausted after three times!

The first wave of attacks by the ghouls is the most sudden and fierce. If the Zerg didn't know the situation in advance and suddenly encountered such a fierce attack, they would really be caught off guard.

In a normal territory, even if they knew the attack method of the ghoul, they would be powerless to stop an attack of such intensity in an instant.

Even though the Zerg was well prepared, it was still so difficult to resist. However, they finally relied on the continuous counterattack of the Zerglings and the continuous and efficient killing ability to barely resist the strongest attack of the Ghouls.

After the accumulated attack, the Ghouls' offensive began to weaken, and the Zerg began to slowly push the front line of the Ghouls back to the outside of the Zerg territory.

When the Zerg pushed the front line to the outer area of the attack range of the defensive buildings, the offensive of both sides seemed to have reached a balance. The Ghouls could not attack the Zerg territory, and the Zerg could not drive the Ghouls away.

The troops of both sides were constantly consumed, and the Zerg had to rely on the counterattack of the Zerglings to offset the continuous and extremely terrifying attack of the Ghouls.

Because the Zerg has a large number of defensive buildings with huge lethality and the support of the Hydralisks, the Ghouls' troop consumption is far greater than that of the Zerg.

But the Ghouls did not give up, and continued to increase their troops to support, maintaining this intensity of offensive, competing with the Zerg in consumption.

The Zerg troops hatched by the Zerg underground base can no longer meet the consumption of the front line, and a large number of Zerg puppies began to enter the underground from the Zerg ground base for support.

All the Zerg broods in the Zerg territory began to hatch puppies with all their strength to maintain the consumption of troops with the ghouls. At this moment, even if the troops are constantly being bred, the system's resources are growing rapidly!

"You think you are consuming my foundation, but in fact you are increasing my foundation!"
